item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-c8c72bc61990239a","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On 30–31 October 2023, Xi Jinping chaired the Central Financial Work Conference and set a program for building a financial power, including strengthening centralized Party leadership over finance, serving the real economy, preventing systemic financial risks, improving financial regulation, and expanding financial opening.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; official policy program, with implementation not established by this source.","ruler_attribution":"The source reports Xi chaired the conference and delivered the principal requirements.","limitations":["The source is an official policy speech and does not independently verify implementation or outcomes.","The extracted text also contains a 2024 follow-up speech outside the target period; this fact is limited to the October 2023 conference material."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cd3e46bef48ecdf0","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"China's official position reiterated a no-first-use nuclear policy, stating that China would never be the first to use nuclear weapons and advocating eventual prohibition and destruction of nuclear weapons.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.5"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Historical policy statement reproduced by the MFA in 2024, not a 2023 event; relevant only as inherited doctrine during the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The statement attributes the position to the Chinese government, not specifically to Xi Jinping.","limitations":["The document concerns 1963–1964 policy statements and provides no evidence of Xi's 2023 decisions, implementation, or operational posture."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9c969e168dd41c1b","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"On 15 March 2023, Xi presented a modernization program centered on people-oriented development, independent national development, continued innovation, inclusive benefits, high-quality development, expanded opening, and peaceful development; he also proposed the Global Civilization Initiative and called for dialogue, cooperation, and opposition to hegemonism.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.3","2B.7","5B.1","5B.6","6B.1","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; establishes stated goals and diplomatic positions, not completed outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"The speech was delivered by Xi as General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President of China.","limitations":["The source is Xi's own official speech and is not independent verification of implementation or truthfulness.","It does not establish that the stated commitments were fully implemented during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f0e2bb40db2c1e7a","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"China hosted and sponsored Saudi-Iranian talks in Beijing from 6–10 March 2023 at Xi Jinping's initiative; Saudi Arabia and Iran agreed to resume diplomatic relations, reopen embassies and missions within two months, respect sovereignty and non-interference, and implement existing security and cooperation agreements.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; records a concrete diplomatic agreement and stated implementation timetable.","ruler_attribution":"The statement identifies Xi's initiative and China's hosting and sponsorship; it was co-signed by representatives of the three states.","limitations":["The document does not independently establish later compliance with the two-month timetable or the durability of the rapprochement.","The statement records the parties' commitments and does not establish that Xi personally negotiated every provision."]},{"source_id":"SRC-10c94676c0a2ddfa","start_unit":1,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"China's official 2023 statistical interpretation reported GDP growth of 5.2% to more than 126 trillion yuan, an average urban surveyed unemployment rate of 5.2%, and 12.44 million new urban jobs; it attributed the employment improvement partly to employment-priority policies.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.9","5B.10","6B.2","6B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers 2023 quantitative outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"The official interpretation attributes the policy direction to the Party Central Committee and State Council under the leadership of Xi Jinping.","limitations":["The figures are from China's official statistics and the interpretation is an official government assessment.","The source does not isolate Xi's causal contribution from broader institutional, subnational, or external factors."]},{"source_id":"SRC-10c94676c0a2ddfa","start_unit":5,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The 2023 official statistical interpretation reported CPI rising 0.2%, goods trade totaling 41.8 trillion yuan with exports up 0.6%, and progress in advanced manufacturing, infrastructure, R&D, clean energy, and private-sector trade; it also reported 3.273 million newly established market entities and private firms accounting for 53.5% of total imports and exports.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.4","5B.6","5B.9","5B.10","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly covers 2023 quantitative outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the policy package and development direction to central authorities under Xi's leadership.","limitations":["The source reports official aggregate indicators and does not independently assess distribution, regulatory fairness, or causal attribution.","The same passage notes continuing challenges including weak demand, excess capacity, weak expectations, and risk exposures."]},{"source_id":"SRC-10c94676c0a2ddfa","start_unit":9,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"The official 2023 statistical interpretation reported real per-capita disposable income growth of 6.1%, a narrowing urban-rural income ratio of 2.39, increased social-insurance enrollment, improved education and health capacity, faster income growth in formerly poor counties, and continued food, energy, and disaster-response measures.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.10","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers 2023 quantitative and institutional outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes these measures to central and local authorities under the Party Central Committee's leadership.","limitations":["The source is an official government interpretation and does not independently verify service quality or equal incidence.","It provides national aggregates and limited evidence about marginalized groups and regional variation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-54df38d8100326c3","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"On 26 April 2023, Xi told Ukrainian President Zelenskyy that China supported peace talks, would not add fuel to the Ukraine crisis or exploit it for gain, opposed nuclear war, would send a special representative to communicate with parties, and would continue humanitarian assistance to Ukraine.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.8","2B.1","2B.7","2B.10","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; records Xi's stated diplomatic decision and planned actions.","ruler_attribution":"The source reports Xi's statements and commitments during the phone call.","limitations":["The source is an official Chinese account of the call and does not independently verify the broader conflict conduct or subsequent effectiveness of the envoy effort.","It records rhetoric and announced assistance, not a completed ceasefire or settlement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0107548e0f26c22e","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"China's Foreign Ministry stated in 2013 that it favored resolving South China Sea disputes with the Philippines through bilateral negotiations and described prior joint marine seismic cooperation, while rejecting Philippine international arbitration and accusing the Philippines of escalation.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.6","2B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Outside the 2023–2023 period; historical context only.","ruler_attribution":"The statement was issued by a Foreign Ministry spokesperson under China's government, without direct attribution to Xi.","limitations":["The document is from 2013 and cannot by itself establish Xi's conduct in 2023.","The account is one-sided and contests the Philippine characterization of events."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ec97fcafdcadc23c","start_unit":2,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"China's 2021 Critical Information Infrastructure Security Protection Regulation assigned coordinating, supervisory, operator, monitoring, emergency-response, annual risk-assessment, information-sharing, and inspection duties for critical infrastructure cybersecurity.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.9","3B.5","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Pre-2023 regulation in force during 2023; establishes inherited legal safeguards.","ruler_attribution":"The regulation was issued by the State Council; the source does not attribute its drafting or enforcement directly to Xi.","limitations":["The document establishes formal rules but provides no evidence of 2023 enforcement quality, independent review, or correction of failures.","The regulation also centralizes state oversight and does not address the full range of AI, biological, or other catastrophic dual-use risks."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ec97fcafdcadc23c","start_unit":5,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"The regulation provides penalties for operators that fail to establish security systems, conduct annual assessments, report incidents, cooperate with inspections, or undergo required security review, and provides sanctions for unlawful intrusion and official misconduct.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.9","3B.5","8B.2","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Pre-2023 regulation in force during 2023; formal enforcement mechanisms were available.","ruler_attribution":"The sanctions are established by the State Council regulation; the source does not show Xi personally enforcing them.","limitations":["No case, inspection result, penalty, or corrective action during 2023 is supplied.","Formal sanctions demonstrate legal design, not actual deterrence or implementation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f974972990343481","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"China signed the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty in 1996 and reiterated support for nuclear prohibition; the treaty includes a verification regime with monitoring, consultation, confidence-building measures, and on-site inspections, but the source states China had not ratified it at the time of publication.","question_ids":["1B.2","1B.3","1B.4","1B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Historical treaty status predating 2023; relevant as inherited arms-control posture.","ruler_attribution":"The source describes China's government position and treaty status, without direct attribution to Xi.","limitations":["The document is historical and does not establish Xi's 2023 policy or any change in ratification status during 2023.","The source does not explain the reasons for non-ratification."]},{"source_id":"SRC-33f8741616e30532","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In January 2022, China's arms-control director described the P5 leaders' joint statement as affirming that nuclear war cannot be won, nuclear weapons serve defensive purposes, weapons were not targeted at one another, arms-control commitments should be preserved, and arms races should be avoided; he said China had helped secure those provisions and favored further strategic-stability dialogue.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Outside the target period; 2022 policy context that remained relevant in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source reports the Foreign Ministry arms-control director's account of China's role and propositions; it does not directly attribute the decisions to Xi.","limitations":["The briefing is from 2022 and does not establish 2023 implementation or operational posture.","It is an official Chinese account and does not independently verify China's negotiating influence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b55ef8d93e69c31b","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In May 2025, China advocated preserving the NPT review structure, consensus working method, balanced treatment of disarmament, nonproliferation, and peaceful uses, and stronger strategic dialogue and mutual trust.","question_ids":["1B.4","8B.1"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Outside the 2023–2023 period; not usable as direct evidence for Xi's 2023 conduct.","ruler_attribution":"The statement is by China's Foreign Ministry delegation, not directly by Xi.","limitations":["The document is from 2025 and is outside the target period.","It provides no evidence of Xi's 2023 decisions, implementation, or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9afcdb4503bb1018","start_unit":2,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"At the July 2024 Third Plenum, Xi delivered a work report and the Central Committee adopted a decision setting reform goals through 2029 and 2035, covering economic governance, innovation, social welfare, rule of law, national security, defense, and foreign policy; the communiqué also confirmed disciplinary expulsions of senior officials.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","6B.1","6B.9","7B.5","7B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.4","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Outside the target period; 2024 institutional context only.","ruler_attribution":"The communiqué states that Xi delivered the work report and spoke on the draft decision; the Central Committee adopted the decision.","limitations":["The document is from July 2024 and cannot establish conduct or outcomes during 2023.","The reform goals are prospective and do not demonstrate implementation or effectiveness."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents are historical or post-2023 and therefore provide context rather than direct evidence for Xi during 2023.","Official Chinese government sources may reflect institutional self-presentation; independent verification, adverse evidence, and implementation records are limited in this batch.","No scores are assigned."]}
